title: Alien Invasion or Sleep Paralysis?

card.teaser: Spreads about the space between dreaming and waking: distorted type, held in place by a strict grid.

summary: Spreads about the uneasy space between dreaming and waking, with distorted type, black-and-white imagery and a strict grid.
meta: Editorial spreads, display type, black-and-white imagery

hero.alt: Black and white magazine spreads with distorted display type.

overview.challenge: Make a half-asleep, liminal experience feel uneasy on the page without making the text hard to read.
overview.solution: Distorted display type for the instability, a structured text grid for clarity, and monochrome imagery for the atmosphere.
overview.outcome: Spreads that hold tension and order at once, like being caught between a dream and waking up.

blocks.label: Why this topic
blocks.text: The topic fascinated me, and it gave me a chance to explore the visual confusion between two surreal experiences.
